## Activity

The site operations record for Hill Counties Health Centre covers June 2024. During the month, the centre completed 115 captures. This figure records the total activity for the reporting period and provides the context for the image-quality and grading measures set out below. The activity level is reported as recorded, without additional interpretation.

## Image quality

Image quality was assessed as part of the routine review process. Of the 115 captures, 9 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 7.8 per cent. The ungradable result is reported separately so that the activity total and the quality measure remain clear. Staff should continue to monitor image quality through normal operational review.

## Grading

A total of 23 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 3 days. These figures provide the recorded grading outcome and the typical wait for review during June 2024. No new equipment faults were raised at Hill Counties Health Centre this month. The activity, image-quality, and grading information should be retained for routine service monitoring and local operational review.
